reviewer.role: assistant visual review; not a geologist
reviewer.inputs: Only blinded-outputs.json, frozen rubric/reference-review.json, and all eight analyzed PNG images were read. No results.json, model mapping, runtime or runner was opened.

methodNotes: The frozen rubric gives 1 point for an omitted category; consequently a nonresponsive answer scores 4/8 but is explicitly not useful. These points are not accuracy or correctness percentages.

The frozen useful-and-grounded rule requires a specific supported visual detail, no substantive visual contradiction and no critical failure. It does not prohibit every noncritical unverified interpretation; those remain separately recorded. Do not read a true value as all claims being reliable.
Material resemblance is distinguished from asserted lithology/mineral identity. Negative statements that properties cannot be seen are not flagged as property predictions.

Critical flags are evaluated contextually, not by keyword. The mineral-composition/deposit speculation in sample-06 Model A is flagged; a natural-versus-mechanical fracture-origin flag is not added because no such cause is asserted.
Token-cap status is retained as supplied in the anonymous packet. No timing, token-count or model-identity inference was used.
Anonymous labels are independently randomized per case. Do not aggregate Model A or Model B across images as a stable model.
Published labels were not used to reward inferred lithology or to treat sample-02 as entirely free of rock.
